title: Remediation
description: A proposed remediation for one Finding (finding.schema.json) — decided at plan 015's kickoff to be its own record, not a retrofit onto Finding (see CONTEXT.md §10.1 and plans/015-action-layer-recommendations-autofix.md). Pure data: this schema describes what could be applied, never something this project's own code applies itself — no field here implies a file was written, a git command was run, or an external API was called.

remediationId.description: Stable identifier for this remediation (hash of findingId + ruleId, mirroring Finding's own findingId convention).

findingId.description: The finding.schema.json Finding this remediation applies to.

ruleId.description: Denormalized from the source Finding for convenience — same value, same naming convention.

safetyTier.description: Per CONTEXT.md §10.1: 'auto-apply' = generic/reversible/no org-specific knowledge required; 'review-required' = a patch exists but needs domain judgment before applying; 'recommend-only' = no patch is possible, the recommendation itself requires org-specific context this skill has no access to. A property of the finding's ruleId/class (see action/safety_tiers.json), occasionally overridden per-finding when location context is ambiguous.

recommendation.description: Actionable guidance — may extend/restate the source Finding's own recommendation field with more specific framing, but is not required to differ from it.

patch.description: Present only when a genuinely mechanical, ruleId-specific transformation exists (v1: secret.* only, see plans/015-action-layer-recommendations-autofix.md). This is data describing a proposed change — never applied by this project's own code.

file.description: Repo-relative path, same convention as Finding's location.file.

originalText.description: The exact text this patch replaces, at `location`.

unifiedDiff.description: Rendered unified-diff string (e.g. via Python's stdlib difflib) for human review or `git apply`.

impactOfFix.description: The proposed fix's own consequences (e.g. 'this tightened IAM policy will block actions X/Y/Z the current one allows') — distinct from finding.schema.json's `impact`, which describes the vulnerability, not the remediation. Present only when `patch` is present.

pullRequestDraft.description: Content only — title/body text for a pull request, for a downstream integration (plan 016) to actually open via a real API. This project's own code never calls that API. Present only when `patch` is present.

detectorSource.description: Which module (and version) produced this remediation, mirroring Finding's own detectorSource.
